id: Community Seed & Plant Swap-Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt-Mangaroa
name: Community Seed & Plant Swap
venue: Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt
long_description:
Join Mangaroa Farms for a Community Seed & Plant Swap, where we gather to share the abundance of our gardens and connect with fellow growers.

We're running a local seed and plant swap right here at the farm, next to the shop. It's a simple kaupapa: bring along any spare seeds or plants you'd like to pass on, pop them on the tables provided, and take home whatever catches your eye. All seeds should be labelled in bags, and plants labelled too so everyone knows what they're getting.

This is a chance to diversify your garden, meet other local growers, and keep the cycle of sharing alive. Whether you're after heritage varieties, curious about something new, or just keen to see what others are growing, you're welcome here.

Mangaroa Farms will have the coffee cart running, and the farm shop will be open if you need to stock up on anything else. Parking will be in a paddock a short walk from the shop.

Remember to bring your own envelopes or bags, labels and a pen to collect any seeds that take your interest.

We will begin at Sat 19th September | 11:00am at 98 Whitemans Valley Road (Garden Tour or Shop). Any questions, please email events@mangaroa.org
